import sys, json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def to_float(x):
    return float(x) if pd.notna(x) else None

def main():
    path = sys.argv[1]
    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    facts = []

    # ---- TOTAL aggregates ----
    total_rev_tw = df['Revenue_TW'].dropna().sum()
    total_rev_lw = df['Revenue_LW'].dropna().sum()
    total_rev_ly = df['Revenue_LY'].dropna().sum()
    total_units_tw = df['Units_TW'].dropna().sum()
    total_units_lw = df['Units_LW'].dropna().sum()
    total_orders_tw = df['Orders_TW'].dropna().sum()
    total_orders_lw = df['Orders_LW'].dropna().sum()

    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "TW",
                  "value": round(to_float(total_rev_tw), 2),
                  "formula": "sum(Revenue_TW)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "LW",
                  "value": round(to_float(total_rev_lw), 2),
                  "formula": "sum(Revenue_LW)"})
    if pd.notna(total_rev_ly) and total_rev_ly != 0:
        facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "LY",
                      "value": round(to_float(total_rev_ly), 2),
                      "formula": "sum(Revenue_LY)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "units", "period": "TW",
                  "value": round(to_float(total_units_tw), 2),
                  "formula": "sum(Units_TW)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "units", "period": "LW",
                  "value": round(to_float(total_units_lw), 2),
                  "formula": "sum(Units_LW)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "orders", "period": "TW",
                  "value": round(to_float(total_orders_tw), 2),
                  "formula": "sum(Orders_TW)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "orders", "period": "LW",
                  "value": round(to_float(total_orders_lw), 2),
                  "formula": "sum(Orders_LW)"})

    if total_rev_lw and total_rev_lw != 0:
        wow_total = (total_rev_tw - total_rev_lw) / total_rev_lw * 100
        facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": round(to_float(wow_total), 1),
                      "formula": "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100"})

    if pd.notna(total_rev_ly) and total_rev_ly != 0:
        yoy_total = (total_rev_tw - total_rev_ly) / total_rev_ly * 100
        facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                      "value": round(to_float(yoy_total), 1),
                      "formula": "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100"})

    # ---- Top 5 entities by Revenue_TW ----
    top5 = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, row in top5.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "TW",
                      "value": round(to_float(row['Revenue_TW']), 2),
                      "formula": "Revenue_TW"})

    # ---- Top 5 entities by Share_Pct ----
    top5_share = df.dropna(subset=['Share_Pct']).sort_values('Share_Pct', ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, row in top5_share.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "share", "period": "TW",
                      "value": round(to_float(row['Share_Pct']), 1),
                      "formula": "Share_Pct"})

    # ---- Top 3 WoW movers ----
    wow_df = df.dropna(subset=['WoW_Pct']).sort_values('WoW_Pct', ascending=False)
    top3_wow = wow_df.head(3)
    for _, row in top3_wow.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": round(to_float(row['WoW_Pct']), 1),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})

    # ---- Top 3 YoY movers ----
    yoy_df = df.dropna(subset=['YoY_Pct']).sort_values('YoY_Pct', ascending=False)
    top3_yoy = yoy_df.head(3)
    for _, row in top3_yoy.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                      "value": round(to_float(row['YoY_Pct']), 1),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})

    # Trim to max 25 facts
    facts = facts[:25]

    print(json.dumps(facts))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
